notes: The manual's pictures are small; piece identities for several steps are inferred from shape/colour and the parts list, so the exact stud/anti-stud port positions are representative, not exact. Each connected pair of pieces gets one joined edge.
No repeats used: the 2x sub-assemblies (clip plate + 1x1 plate, wing tip tiles, wheels) are written out as individual parts with their own ids.
The minifigure (head, helmet, goggles, torso, legs) is not in the parts list, so it is not modelled. The backpack (b68) has no ports and is shown as resting on the seat.
Step 1-2: 4856a is placed on the red 2x10 plate end, and two 4854 pieces go along its sides. 4855 closes the nose end in step 4. Which yellow piece goes where is a best guess.
Wedge plates 47397/47398 and tail wing 2340 have no anti-stud ports in the catalogue, so some edges use a null port on those pieces.
Step 25 wheel plate 30157 is shown attached to the underside of the black 2x4 b5, as the underside view suggests. Wheels are pinned on the plate pins and the tyres are stretched onto the wheels.
Propeller is placed on the axle in step 22/23 (it first appears in the step 23 picture). The stickers (b104) are applied to the tail fin and the wing roundel tiles in step 26.
Pickaxe and shovel are clipped on the 1x1 clip plates b34/b35. Sextant and binoculars are clipped on the clips of the 3839b handle plate.
